name: Privacy Controls
author: groot
description: One-click microphone mute and webcam power-off in the bar, with udev-backed webcam state that survives reboot/resume.

barWidget.description: Bar icon that reflects mic/webcam state; click for mute + webcam-power toggles. The webcam toggle needs a one-time 'sudo setup_udev.sh' (the panel copies the command).
